description:
Design (page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.20.html, revision 2; APPROVED 2026-10-17; match Elixir):
- Pattern::As(Var, Box<Pattern>) becomes Pattern::Both(Box<Pattern>, Box<Pattern>).
- The decoder (quoted_function.rs:538) decodes both sides with decode_pattern.
- All 13 sites handle both sides on the same subject:
  - the planner append_pattern (pattern.rs:720);
  - bind_pattern (body.rs:3019) and apply_pattern (:2946);
  - the collectors at body.rs:685, 4057 and 4258, and source.rs:148, 237 and 257;
  - literal_from_pattern and pattern_name.
- Reachability and the interp, native and receive paths are unchanged, because they see only the compiled plan.
- Removes: As and its asymmetry; the internal "as-bind lhs must be a variable" error; the Var|As re-match in collect_bound_names_in_pattern; pattern_var_name's use in = (^ keeps it).
- Oracle fixture for %{} = m, m = %{}, {a, _} = {_, b} and [h | _] = [_, x | _] = l, in heads, case, fn and body match, on all three paths. The builder confirms that a duplicate identical question on one subject compiles.
- Repeated-variable equality is fz-sc8.26, which this ticket blocks.
title: p1 = p2 in a pattern matches both
